title: Cancel a subscription
subtitle: Finds what you pay for, and cancels it with your yes
description: Name a subscription, or ask what you are paying for. Your Sylo finds the receipts and renewal notices in your email, shows the price and the next charge, and goes through the service’s cancel steps, turning down the offers to stay. It stops before the last button to show you what ends and when, and cancels only after your yes.
asks: Cancel my Spotify before it renews.
What am I paying for every month?
browserNote: It opens the service’s page and signs in with your saved login.
